sources.title: qwen-omni-turbo model information (Japanese documentation)
sources.evidence: Official model page, updated October 1, 2026, lists the exact stable API ID, equivalence to the March 26, 2025 snapshot, 32,768-token context (30,720 input plus 2,048 output), four input modalities, text/audio output, and unsupported function calling in Beijing and Singapore. English counterpart redirected to the general models page.

sources.title: Model lifecycle and updates
sources.evidence: China (Beijing) release table explicitly lists qwen-omni-turbo and qwen-omni-turbo-latest on February 14, 2025. It separately lists the January 19 snapshot on March 17 and the March 26 snapshot on March 27; the international API release is July 18, 2025.

sources.title: Qwen2.5-Omni official repository README
sources.evidence: Official Qwen repository describes the open Qwen2.5-Omni checkpoints and Thinker-Talker design, while API examples call qwen-omni-turbo. This connects the endpoint to Qwen/Alibaba but does not explicitly equate its complete weights, total/active parameter counts or exact architecture with a released checkpoint.

sources.title: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio model pricing
sources.evidence: Indexed official pricing table (retrieved in web search) labels qwen-omni-turbo and its snapshots Non-Thinking mode, and the stable alias equivalent to the March 26 snapshot. The newer directly opened page no longer included these older rows; this evidence is the retained indexed primary page, not a live API test.

name.note: Human-readable normalization of the documented qwen-omni-turbo identifier.

developer.note: Official repository API example identifies Qwen Team, Alibaba Group.

family.note: The official Qwen project provides this endpoint as its Omni API service.

release_date.note: Earliest explicitly listed release of this undated API ID is Beijing, February 14. Baseline January 19 is a snapshot date, not the documented release of this alias. International launch followed July 18.

open_weights.note: No downloadable weights for this exact hosted ID were established. Open Qwen2.5-Omni checkpoints exist, but the API example is insufficient proof of checkpoint identity. Baseline false is plausible and left unchanged, with this verification limitation.

license.note: No exact-endpoint weight license established; licenses of separate downloadable Qwen2.5-Omni checkpoints are not transferred to the service.

parameters_b.note: No total parameter count for the exact hosted Turbo model is disclosed in the consulted primary sources. Do not copy a 3B/7B open-checkpoint label.

active_parameters_b.note: No per-token active count disclosed for this endpoint; neither a dense-model equality nor an MoE count is assumed.

architecture.note: The public open model uses Thinker-Talker, but no explicit exact hosted revision identity or dense/MoE specification was established. Keep architecture null.

context_window.note: Documented total context; input/output limits are 30,720/2,048 tokens.

modalities.note: Inputs: text, image, audio, video. Outputs: text, audio.

reasoning.note: Official indexed pricing labels this endpoint Non-Thinking. This means no dedicated thinking mode, not absence of general reasoning ability. Fresh page has removed the legacy row.

tool_call.note: Function Calling is explicitly unsupported; baseline true is contradicted.

description.value: Hosted Qwen multimodal model accepting text, images, audio, and video and generating streamed text and speech.
description.note: Replaces unsupported agent-task framing with documented input/output behavior.

patch.description: Hosted Qwen multimodal model accepting text, images, audio, and video and generating streamed text and speech.

sources.label: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio model pricing

summary: Correct release date from snapshot date 2025-01-19 to documented alias release 2025-02-14, set tool_call false, and remove unsupported agent-task wording. Confirm 32,768-token context and modalities. Stable alias is documented as March 26 snapshot-equivalent. Exact endpoint total/active parameters, architecture and weight license remain undisclosed; open-weight status was not independently established beyond its hosted-service presentation. Dedicated non-thinking classification is supported by indexed official legacy pricing, whose rows have since disappeared from the directly opened page. No open-checkpoint parameter or architecture values were transferred.
